edges.subject: ATP13A2
edges.quote: These disorders result from variants in ATP13A2 which encodes a putative transmembrane ion transporter important for lysosomal function.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are lysosomal storage disorders characterized by progressive neurodegeneration and declines in neurological functions.

edges.subject: CLN12 disease
edges.quote: Three Australian Cattle Dogs (a female and two of her offspring) were identified with a progressive neurological disorder with an onset of clinical signs at approximately 6 years of age.
